- Repository: `404oops/immersion`.
- Agreement: [CLA.md](../CLA.md), version 1 (2026-10-03).
- Published agreement: [public GitHub gist](https://gist.github.com/404oops/39acdad2e557730c28e8d2fb54296f7b).
- Service: [CLA Assistant](https://cla-assistant.io/).

The gist was published and verified against the local agreement. Repository linking is pending: Immersion is private and is absent from the hosted service's repository selector under the current authorization. CLA enforcement is not active yet. Do not treat the existence of this file or the gist as a completed integration or a contributor signature.

When the repository is available in the service, link it to the gist above without minimum file or line thresholds, so small contributions also require agreement. Verify the linked repository and CLA status in the dashboard. Keep the gist and local agreement synchronized when publishing an updated version.

To enforce acceptance at merge time, require the CLA status check in the repository's branch protection or ruleset after verifying its actual check name. Also require `Check agent disclosure` once that workflow is present on the default branch. No branch protection settings have been changed as part of this setup.
